attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to permit and log TCP/23 transit traffic from node3 to node4, and node2 (OPNsense) to refuse (pf reject/block-return) and log that same traffic, with node3's route forcing the flow through node1 then node2. Captured a correlated log pair from a single connection attempt showing the traffic passing node1 and stopping at node2. All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time (native reboot), with boot-identity change verified and post-restart health/config/log-pair re-verified for each.
